Name: Abiram, Son of Hiel
Summary: Abiram was Hiel's firstborn, in whom Hiel laid Jericho's foundation, according to the word of Joshua.
KeyStory: Abiram, in whom Jericho's foundation was laid.
RelatedPeople: Hiel the Bethelite; Segub, Son of Hiel
LifeLesson: A child's life spent on a father's ambition is a sober warning.
